laneA_nativePairedAmtTruth.definition: real audio + synchronized same-performance MIDI; evaluates recovered notes/onsets independently of score following
missingBeforeUse: candidate identities and browser runtime identities frozen prospectively

missingBeforeUse: public-proxy labeling that does not imply native NoteVerse microphone capture
